item.tib: bdud 'dul dbang khrid gsal ba'i me long
item.coloph: mthar thug dgongs 'dus bdud 'dul gsang ba'i bon/ gdams pa zab mo 'dren pa'i skyobs rje 'di/ ma 'ong ('ongs) dus mtha' gnas chen brag dkar rdzongs (rdzong /)me pho spel lo lug zla tshes bzang la/ ma 'ong ('ongs) kho bo pad ma g.yung drung la/ mkha' 'gro ma'i zabs (mas zab) mo bsnyen (snyan) du brgyud/ de nas dus tshod smon lam brten (rten) 'brel 'dzoms/ skal ldan gshen pos (po'i) rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 'gro la phan phyir yi ge 'di bkod pa'i (pas/)nyes 'gal ci mchis mkha' 'gro nyid la bshag (bshags/) mtha' yas 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog ces gsungs so/ s+ya mya ya/ ces pa'i tshul 'di ni/ gser ldan chu bo chen po'i g.yas zur/ gang (gangs) brag rin chen spungs pa'i mdun/ nag (nags) tshal ljon phyugs (phyug) gzha' tshon gyis (gyi) gling / dben gnas mchog gyur mdzod nag bkra shis lhun grub gyis (kyi) khrod du bkod pa'o/ dge legs 'phel//
